title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
lineage: Master Cassette Transfer->RR ->Cassette Transfer/editing//flac Conversion: Brian Mandel Cassette Transfer Nakamichi BX300-> Macintosh ->Peak Bias->JAM->cdr->EAC->flac

ai_review.summary: Warm audience recording of a stellar 1973 show, praised for its excellent performance and pleasant sound.
ai_review.review: All four reviewers gush about this March‑19 1973 concert, calling it an excellent show with a warm, inviting audio feel. The audience (AUD) source provides a nicely balanced, slightly mellow sound that captures the vibe of the era without any reported technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer stars (5, 5, 5, 4) and uniformly positive language indicate both a superb performance and a good‑quality audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, slightly mellow tone; no complaints about dropouts or distortion – reviewers describe it as “nice warm recording” and “warm AUD”.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers emphasize the overall energy and gratitude for the show, noting that the 1973 era fits their ‘wheelhouse’ and the performance feels consistently strong throughout.
